caption: One shared var i makes all three 0 ms callbacks print 3; each let j is a fresh binding, so the 10 ms timers print 0, 1, 2; add(2, 3) prints 5 at 20 ms.

spec.title: What each timer prints, in order
spec.aria: Three rows of printed values in timer order: the var loop's three callbacks all print 3 at 0 ms, the let loop's timers print 0, 1 and 2 at 10 ms, and add(2, 3) prints 5 at 20 ms.
